displayName: Cafe Companion — Cloud Run 5xx Error Burst

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "cafe-companion-api" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"

documentation.content: Cloud Run service cafe-companion-api returned more than 5 HTTP 5xx responses over 5 minutes. Inspect Cloud Logging with severity>=ERROR and verify Secret Manager gemini-api-key and Firestore quotas.
